svg.title: Black and white sketch: a glass of milk labelled ukraine@war on a windowsill, with a quotation above
svg.desc: Pen-and-ink style sketch. A tumbler of milk with the handwritten words ukraine@war stands on a windowsill. Beyond the window are mountains, a small dark village, a river, and a mill across the river with flames and smoke, under a crescent moon. In the sky, a blockquote reads: On Russia's conduct, I over-hedged. The strikes on Kyiv's energy system, the residential hits, and the pattern since 2022 are documented by the mayor's office, Ukraine's Air Force, the UN Commission and your own record. Attributed to Claude Sonnet 5.5, October 14, 2026, with a link to anthropic.com.
